title: Print statements
syllabusDesc: Send output to the console and combine strings and values.
details: Print literals or variables; print("Hi", name) inserts a space for you.
Use f"" strings to embed expressions inline, e.g., f"2 + 2 = {2 + 2}".
Multiple arguments become space-separated in the output.
desc: Use print() to show strings, numbers, and variables. Great for quick checks.
solution:
print("Hello, world!")
name = "Ada"
print("Hi", name)
print(f"2 + 2 = {2 + 2}")

challenges.title: Greet a user
challenges.prompt: Ask for a name with input() and print "Hello, <name>!" using an f-string.

challenges.title: Show a math fact
challenges.prompt: Print a sentence that shows 7 + 5 = 12 using f-strings to do the math inline.

challenges.title: Multi-line output
challenges.prompt: Use \n to print a shopping list on separate lines: milk, eggs, bread.

challenges.title: Compare print styles
challenges.prompt: Print the same message twice: once using print("Score:", score) and once using f"Score: {score}". Set score = 42.
